summary: In this tutorial on LibreOffice Impress, you learn how to create custom animations for your presentations using the Linux operating system and the LibreOffice suite version 3.3.4. To start, open a sample presentation and select the first text box on the slide using the text pen tool. Click on the text box to highlight it, then click on the border to access the custom animation feature. In the custom animation box, choose the entrance tab to control how objects appear on the screen. You can set the speed and direction of the animation by selecting the appropriate options from the dropdown menus. Multiple animations can be added and ordered, with each one starting after the previous one ends. For example, you can change the direction of the animation from right to top, affecting its path and position. Adjustments can also be made to the timing of the animations, such as adding a delay before they start. By playing and reviewing these animations, you can see the effects of your changes and make further adjustments as needed.
